summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. (NYSE: CAAP) furnished a routine Form 6-K on October 16, 2026, carrying an Exhibit 99.1 press release reporting September 2026 passenger traffic. Total traffic rose 3.4% year over year to 7.678 million passengers, with international up 7.2% and Argentina up 1.7% to a September record; nine-month traffic gained 2.5%. Cargo edged up 0.8% and aircraft movements were flat. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Watch for the Flybondi capacity gap and Argentine domestic recovery as the operative traffic variables.
